Game Overview

In Square Jump, the core idea is straightforward: leap into endless fun with Square Jump. Bounce a square between walls, timing your jumps to pass through circles. As speed increases, sharpen your reflexes and aim for the highest score. With its minimalistic design and addictive gameplay, it's perfect for quick, thrilling sessions.
